### Required review gates
- [ ] New/modified beats registered in data/beat_contracts.json and validate.
- [ ] Narrative source truth, spatial cues and player actions agree.
- [ ] Presentation cannot gate a valid action without documented reason.
- [ ] Guard hearing/sight only follow physical evidence; no omniscient AI.
- [ ] Interrupted and replayed cues never duplicate committed event flags.
- [ ] Non-audio and non-colour-only routes cover critical clues.
- [ ] All six gameplay-facing channels reviewed together, not silo-approved.
- [ ] Compilation and packaged playtesting claims are backed by evidence, or explicitly remain incomplete.

See docs/DOCTRINE_004_INTEGRATED_EXPERIENCE.md.
